## Download

| System | File | |
|---|---|---|
| 🪟 **Windows** 10/11 | `EmuHub-Setup.exe` | Installs for your user (no admin), with desktop and Start menu shortcuts. Windows may warn the first time: More info → Run anyway. `emuhub-windows.exe` is a portable copy that doesn't update itself. |
| 🍎 **macOS** 10.15+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `EmuHub.dmg` | Drag EmuHub to Applications. First open: right-click → Open, or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. |
| 🐧 **Linux / SteamOS** | `EmuHub-x86_64.AppImage` | Make it executable (right-click → Properties → Permissions, or `chmod +x`) and run it. Gear Lever adds it to the app menu with its icon. On the Steam Deck, add it to Steam as a non-Steam game for Game Mode. `emuhub-linux` is the same app without the icon and menu entry. |

EmuHub offers new versions in a popup and installs them when you press Update (the installer, the Mac app and the AppImage update themselves; downloads are checked against `SHA256SUMS`). It doesn't include games, BIOS files, keys or firmware; use your own.
